summary_en: This phase 2 study tests ruxolitinib added to pembrolizumab in adults with relapsed or refractory Hodgkin or non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Ruxolitinib is taken by mouth at 20 mg twice daily, and pembrolizumab is given into a vein at 200 mg every 21 days, both for as long as the disease responds, up to one year (17 cycles). The record does not state a primary outcome measure; its stated purpose is to determine whether the combination is safe and effective.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa ruxolitinib añadido a pembrolizumab en adultos con linfoma de Hodgkin o no Hodgkin recidivante o refractario. El ruxolitinib se toma por vía oral a 20 mg dos veces al día, y el pembrolizumab se administra por vena a 200 mg cada 21 días, ambos mientras la enfermedad responda, hasta un año (17 ciclos). El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; su objetivo declarado es determinar si la combinación es segura y eficaz.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory Hodgkin, PMBCL, gray zone, or T-cell lymphoma, as listed in the record.
Received at least one prior systemic therapy line; some subtypes require prior CD30-directed therapy.
Measurable disease on PET-CT performed within 4 weeks.
ECOG 0-2 or Karnofsky score of 50 or higher, with adequate blood counts and organ function.
not_for: Autoimmune disease that requires systemic treatment.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or expected to conceive during the study.
Severe (grade 3 or higher) hypersensitivity to pembrolizumab or ruxolitinib.
